name: Retail Dates
description: Confirmed dates for shopping events that people plan around: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Small Business Saturday, Amazon Prime Day and similar sales, plus store hours on Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and New Year, holiday shipping and return deadlines and seasonal restaurant menus. Stories only report a date once the retailer or organizer announces it, state the time zone when an event starts at a set hour, and say when a date is only an estimate based on past years. Each piece links to the matching when-is page and the month calendar so readers can block the date ahead of time.
